methods.E: normalized leaf equality (compact length >= 20) and equality of normalized canonical-JSON states (canonical-JSON strings decoded first)
methods.L: S rule against 400/200 windows (last window end-aligned) of the compact text of protected leaves > 800 chars; candidate units are 200/100 windows of leaves over 200 compact chars, else the leaf
methods.N: word 13-grams over word_tokens and compact 30-grams kept iff int.from_bytes(blake2b(utf8, digest_size=8, person), 'big') % 4 == 0; only 8-byte hashes are stored
methods.S: audit_vitaminc_score rule against protected leaves <= 800 normalized chars: compact 6-gram sets, every 2nd sorted protected gram indexed, the 6 rarest candidate grams by (posting length, gram), postings <= 128, Jaccard >= 0.72 or containment >= 0.9
methods.boilerplate: a matched unit in >= 5 distinct candidate groups, or an N gram in >= 5 distinct protected rows; reported separately and never quarantining
